rationale: The agent only bumped the version string in package.json but made no changes to lib/css-converter.js, which imports and instantiates the old CssSelectorParser API. The v2 API is completely different (createParser factory, changed AST property names), so the existing code fails with 'CssSelectorParser is not a constructor'. The reference patch shows extensive required source changes that were omitted.
